title: Will AI Concerns Become a New Source of Terrorism?
summary_en: What is the risk that fears about AI will motivate terrorist attacks? This analysis examines the record of anti-AI violence so far, how and why new terrorist causes emerge, and what that history suggests for AI-related violence.

title: Throttling Starlink Is a Disaster for Ukraine and the United States
summary_en: In demonstrating its unreliability as a security partner, the United States is eroding allied trust in U.S. defense and technology suppliers and in NATO.

title: Sustaining South Africa’s Progress in the Next Phase of the HIV Fight
summary_en: South Africa has 8 million people living with HIV, and the government has introduced lenacapavir, a new HIV prevention drug. Thousands have started on the injections, but questions about future costs and supplies will need to be resolved to ensure the campaign’s success.

title: Risk to Refugee Return
summary_en: This installment of Charting the Middle East highlights how the scale of unexploded ordnance (UXO) contamination, relative to returning populations, varies across Syria.
